maria-l: We're seeing nodepool scale-up failures in ap-northeast1 during GPU onboarding — k8s shows 'failed to allocate 1 public IP' on 3 nodes. Anyone else?
infra-bot: autoscaler: scale_up_failed for nodepool gpu-large-apn1 (3 nodes) — reason: network_resource_allocation_failed
cheng-wu: saw this earlier in the logs. Cloud API returns ENI quota_exceeded and EIP_pool_exhausted errors for that region.
maria-l: I'm opening a support case now. Which exact quotas should we request increase for? ENIs per subnet, EIPs per region, assignable IPv4s per VPC, and maybe IPv6 prefix delegation?
sam-dev: Case opened: 123456789. Initial repro shows ENI attach failures + EIP allocation timeouts. Recommend asking for: Elastic IPs -> 150, ENIs per subnet -> 250, IPv6 prefixes -> +4. Also note ephemeral NAT consumption from GPU nodes spiking.
ryan-k: Quick cost/security note: reserving lots of EIPs increases attack surface and bookkeeping. Alternative: request additional subnet prefixes (/28s or /26s), or enable IPv6-only internal addressing with NAT64 for egress. Also check instance public-ip affinity option.
anya: We hit transient "allocator: no available prefix" when APAC bolus created ~40 GPU instances simultaneously. Suggest temporary rollout window + staggered node creation.
cheng-wu: Adding actual error blob: ```Error allocating network resources: ENI quota exceeded for subnet subnet-0a1b2c: limit 256, used 256
Failed to attach EIP: region ap-northeast1 resource exhausted (EIP pool)
Caused by bulk simultaneous CreateNetworkInterface + AssociateAddress calls```
maria-l: I'll attach these logs to the support case. Can someone draft the exact quota numbers and justification? We need a business case: Dedicated pool capacity reservation for Q2 launch.
sam-dev: Draft proposal for ap-northeast1: EIPs -> 400, ENIs per subnet -> 512, IPv4 addresses per subnet -> 2048, IPv6 prefixes -> +8. Justification: GPU Dedicated pool planned for Q2, forecast 1200 GPU nodes over 6 months. Attaching forecast CSV to case. :chart_with_upwards_trend:
ryan-k: Playing devil's advocate — 400 EIPs likely to be rejected. Recommend asking for 200 EIPs + programmatic ability to expand prefixes on demand, and SLA for quota review. Also ask cloud to enable faster provisioning path for us (support tier note).
maria-l: Good call. I'll request 200 EIPs + programmatic prefix expansion + ENI per-subnet 512. Also ask for 'assignable IPs per VPC' to be increased to 8192. Will include traffic growth and commit numbers.
infra-bot: Support case 123456789 updated: status = awaiting_cloud_response — last update 2026-01-12T15:42:00Z
anya: Quick infra checklist: 1) update runbook to stagger nodepool creation 2) enable prefix delegation in VPC config 3) fallback to private-only GPU nodes (no external IP) for canary 4) add alert when assignable ip util > 80%. I'll update runbook.
maria-l: Also adding a short-term workaround: change k8s service controller to avoid assigning externalIPs by default on GPU node labels. PR coming.
cheng-wu: FYI cloud vendor note: when requesting ENI increases they often ask for 'network interfaces per instance' and 'security group rules' increases as well — adding those to the case.
sam-dev: Timeline: if cloud approves in 48-72h we can do a weekend canary, otherwise we'll run a staged rollout with 10% nodepool increments next week.
maria-l: Thanks all — I'll update the thread when support responds. :pray:
